title: Your Name, O Lord, Endures Forever

questions.question: Praise the Lord! Praise the name of the Lord, give praise, O servants of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 135:1 (ESV): "give praise, O servants of the Lord,"

questions.question: Who stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 135:2 (ESV): "...in the courts of the house of our God!"

questions.question: Praise the Lord, for the Lord is good; sing to his name, for it is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 135:3 (ESV): "...sing to his name, for it is pleasant!"

questions.question: For the Lord has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel as his own what?
For I know that the Lord is great, and that our Lord is above all what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 135:5 (ESV): "and that our Lord is above all gods."

questions.question: He raises the mist from the ends of the earth; he makes lightnings for the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 135:7 (ESV): "...he makes lightnings for the rain,"

questions.question: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 135:8 (ESV): "...both of man and of beast."

questions.question: He struck down many nations and killed mighty kings: Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of what?
Your name, O Lord, endures forever, your renown, O Lord, throughout all what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 135:13 (ESV): "...your renown, O Lord, throughout all generations."

questions.question: Cruel idols have mouths but do not speak; eyes but do not see; ears but do not what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 135:17 (ESV): "they have ears, but do not hear,"

questions.question: Nor is there any what in their mouths?
questions.explanation: Psalm 135:17 (ESV): "nor is there any breath in their mouths."

questions.question: Those who make them become like them, so do all who trust in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 135:18 (ESV): "...so do all who trust in them!"

questions.question: The Lord will vindicate his people and have compassion on his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 135:14 (ESV): "...and have compassion on his servants."

questions.question: House of Israel, bless the Lord! House of Aaron, bless the Lord! House of Levi, bless the Lord! You who do what, bless the Lord!
questions.explanation: Psalm 135:20 (ESV): "You who fear the Lord, bless the Lord!"

questions.question: Blessed be the Lord from where, who dwells in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Psalm 135:21 (ESV): "Blessed be the Lord from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem!"

key_verse_text: Praise the Lord! Praise the name of the Lord, give praise, O servants of the Lord,
